=Get Transaction ID from Image in JSON format
{
  "type": "{type}",
  "class": "{class}",
  "timestamp": "{timestamp}",
  "transac_id": "{id}",
  "amount": "{amount}",
  "fee": "{fee}",
  "note": "{note}",
}

timestamp: DateTime format YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm
type: "expense","income", "other" เท่านั้น
type: "other" คือข้อความที่ไม่ใช่ "expense" และ "income"
และถ้าเป็น "expense" เป็นclassไหน โดยดูจาก note และ receiver
class: เป็นไปได้แค่ "food","beverage","transfer","bill","Fare","shopping","Subscription","other"

"Food","Beverage","Transfer","Bill","Shopping","Fare","Subscription","Other"
